reason: A local DeepSeek Harness usage and cost dashboard that visualizes token consumption, estimated billing, pricing changes, model breakdowns, trends, budgets, and shareable billing cards.

summaries.zh: 用于在本机统计和可视化 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量、模型费用、价格变化、趋势与预算信息。
summaries.en: A local dashboard for tracking and visualizing DeepSeek Harness token usage, estimated model costs, pricing changes, trends, and budgets.

capabilities: Reads local dsh session logs for token usage records
Calculates token usage and estimated costs from configured pricing data
Stores usage records locally in JSONL files
Optionally queries the DeepSeek API for account balance when an API key is configured
Optionally fetches a remote pricing table when enabled
